style.id: Speak Indonesian slowly, cheerfully, and clearly, like reading a picture book to a toddler. Read the transcript exactly as written, word for word. Do not add, remove, or translate any words. Pronounce every word, including interjections, in Indonesian.
style.en: Speak English slowly, cheerfully, and clearly, like reading a picture book to a toddler. Read the transcript exactly as written, word for word. Do not add, remove, or change any words.
